subject: Official signal hierarchy: route events are not geometry or presentation readiness
body: HEAD=413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. CONFIRMED from current source + Android docs + peer evidence: Fold7DeviceStateObserver is correctly wake/edge-only and explicitly not hinge geometry; DisplayManager callbacks describe logical display add/change/remove and current main uses them for route/engine reconciliation; MainActivity's Jetpack FoldingFeature only supplies activity-window fold-line geometry and does not drive the system-wide continuity service; PowerManager.isInteractive is global interaction state, not per-display screen/panel readiness. Agent03 independently confirms physical power, logical route, and renderability are separate layers; Agent04 confirms WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY success does not establish first presentable pixel. Recommendation: one precise physical-angle authority; DeviceStateManager only as optional early opening edge if timing proves benefit; DisplayManager for logical-route lifecycle; Display.getState as a per-logical-display guard but not physical identity/readiness; public TYPE_HINGE_ANGLE on Fold7 only corroboration/recovery while it remains coarse; FoldingFeature/configuration/screen broadcasts outside production transition authority. Do not infer renderability from logical callbacks or wake ACK.
